Page 9 of 16 
 
and for once could do nothing, 
perhaps a huge silence 
might interrupt this sadness 
of never understanding ourselves 
and of threatening ourselves with death.  
(Keeping Quiet) 
i Which of these does the speaker imply through the following lines: 
 
Life is what it is about; 
I want no truck with death.
options: Life is meant to be lived and death should not be the focus here.

Life is meant to teach us lessons and near-death experiences are not 
always bad.

Life is full of adventures and the fear of death should not stop us 
from exploring them all.

Life is full of many choices and thoughts about death should not be 
a point of consideration.

questions.explanation: CBSE English Core Practice Paper (PQ1) Marking Scheme: Option A.

questions.question: What does the speaker mean when he describes people as 'single-minded'?
options: People who only work towards understanding themselves.
People who are driven by only one passion in their life.
People who only focus on rushing through their life.

People who can focus on only one task at a time. 
1
questions.explanation: CBSE English Core Practice Paper (PQ1) Marking Scheme: Option C.

questions.question: What effect does the phrase 'open mouthed' have on the poem?
options: It builds a mood of surprise and shock in the poem.
It reveals the speaker's fear of her own death and mortality.
It adds to the imagery of the speaker's mother appearing dead.

It highlights the speaker's attempt at hiding her emotions from her mother. 
1
questions.explanation: CBSE English Core Practice Paper (PQ1) Marking Scheme: Option C.
